target: Prioritize errors in an existing MNDWI>0 binary total-surface-water result for review
development_population: The six already consumed fixed WorldFloods windows, using existing cropped green/NIR/SWIR and matching newly fetched red
verification_population: All four named unopened reserve activations, fixed native centre 512 by 512 pixels; failed cases retained, no replacements
baseline: MNDWI>0; retain the water decision in the review experiment
support: For all methods use finite strictly positive values in all four bands and strictly positive denominators; evaluation further restricts to reference clear and known land/water. Reference support is used only for scoring.

review_priorities.ndwi: Prioritize opposite NDWI>0 versus MNDWI>0 decisions, then ascending absolute MNDWI
review_priorities.ndvi: Prioritize MNDWI water with NDVI>0.2, then ascending absolute MNDWI
review_priorities.either: Prioritize either flag, then ascending absolute MNDWI

primary_comparison: 20% event-specific budget, NDWI plus NDVI (either) vs MNDWI margin, reporting each event and pooled paired counts; 10% sensitivity, NDWI-only/NDVI-only ablations and random expectation are secondary
metrics: Review count, captured baseline mistakes, missed baseline mistakes, false positive and false negative captures, precision, mistake recall, unreviewed error rate and event-level paired counts. Baseline mistakes use independent benchmark labels after sealing. Random expectation is budget multiplied by baseline error prevalence.
interpretation: Correlated spectral consistency cues, not independent confirmation, confidence probabilities, improved accuracy without correction, or infrastructure exposure validation. Whole-window fixed review budget is a benchmark simulation and no human reviewer corrects any result.
freeze: Freeze methods, thresholds, cohort and metrics before reading new reference pixels; no post-score parameter changes
publication: Local research artifacts; benchmark imagery and labels remain local
